description: Exact split of the change in the log fatal share into the change in fatal crashes (numerator) and in crashes with a determinable outcome (denominator), annual averages, under both outcome definitions; comparisons: 2020-24 and each later year vs 2016-19, 2021 vs 2019, 2024 vs 2021, 2024 vs 2019; FARS census ratio for the numerator
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with known maximum severity
method: Weighted totals, joint linearisation (CIs cover CRSS sampling only); FARS observed counts

definitions.fatal_cc: complete-case maximum severity (MAX_SEV; crashes with a person of unknown severity excluded unless fatal)
